taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-01 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 332.5 | 0.52 | 0.52
2 | 601.3 | 6.89 | 7.41
3 | 359.9 | 16.01 | 23.42
4 | 286.0 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KQ-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-01
Curve type: KQ-type
Aquifer depth: 7.41 – 23.42 m (extending below 23.42 m)
Recommendation: Drill to a minimum depth of 30–35 m to fully exploit the lower-resistivity weathered and fractured saturated zones identified from 7.41 m downward. Install solid casing through the upper 7.41 m of overburden and place well screens across the main productive intervals below 7.41 m.
